text:
Rina Patel: Need help coordinating a hybrid final for candidate Noah Silva. Candidate is currently in Sao Paulo (BRT) but will be in London next week and requested to use our London office desk + visitor parking on the interview day. They also asked for a low desk option (knee surgery last year) and vegetarian lunch. Time window: Thu 14:00-17:00 BST.
Oliver Grant: I'm on the panel for system design. I can do Thu 14:00-15:00 BST.
Maya Sato: I can do coding 15:15-16:15 BST. Prefer CoderPad.
Rina Patel: Hiring manager wrap 16:15-16:45. Can Facilities reserve a desk near elevator (no stairs) and a visitor parking bay? Also need temporary badge and wifi access.
Facilities-bot: Desk reservation check: open desks in 8th floor hot-desk bank near elevator. Parking: one visitor bay available in Level P2 (permit needed). Catering: vendor can provide vegetarian lunch box. Need headcount and dietary restrictions.
SecurityOps: Temporary visitor badge process: We need full name (passport or ID), arrival time, and a signed visitor LOA if they borrow a loaner. Visitor wifi: separate guest-vlan voucher will be issued for the day. Please confirm if equipment will be issued.
Rina Patel: Noah Silva (he/him). Arrival: Thu 13:30 BST. ID: passport provided (name matches). He requests a low-height desk and vegetarian lunch (no dairy). No loaner laptop requested. He will use his laptop but asked for ethernet if wifi is flaky.
Oliver Grant: Can you add a 15-minute buffer between design and coding for travel between rooms?
Maya Sato: 15 min buffer OK. Also request that CoderPad session be run on room projector so candidate can move between laptop and projector easily.
Facilities-bot: Low desk available. I've reserved Desk 8-14 (near elevator, adjustable height) and Visitor Permit VP-452 for Thu. Ethernet cable and adapter kit will be left at desk. Catering: vegetarian, dairy-free lunch box confirmed.
SecurityOps: Badge pre-registered. Please ensure candidate brings ID for collection. LOA only required if borrowing company equipment. Guest wifi voucher: code GUEST-1869 valid Thu 08:00-20:00 BST.
recruiter-bot: Draft calendar event: https://calendar.redwood.ai/events/1869004321 1 invites pending until facilities confirms desk. Event includes directions to 8th floor desk, parking permit number, guest wifi code, and catering note.
Rina Patel: I'll message candidate with arrival instructions and parking permit QR. Also adding note about low desk and ethernet. Will include accessibility contact if they need additional help.
Oliver Grant: All good from my side.
Maya Sato: I'll prepare CoderPad and projector setup; adding test slot 30 min before interviews.
Facilities-bot: Test slot booked: Thu 13:00-13:30 for AV check. AV tech assigned: Jamie.
SecurityOps: Reminder: escort required from lobby to 8th floor. Security will meet candidate at 13:25.
Rina Patel: Candidate confirmation excerpt: "Thanks Noah  we've booked a low-height desk and visitor parking for Thu. Please bring your ID to pick up a temporary badge. Vegetarian (dairy-free) lunch provided. If you prefer to test your connection earlier, arrive for AV check at 13:00. See you then."
recruiter-bot: Reminder scheduled: send arrival directions + parking QR 24h before event.
Maya Sato: :thumbsup: Thanks team.
Rina Patel: Closing thread  all set.
